gloss: chance; fate; destiny; twist of fate

definitions.gloss: chance; fate; destiny; twist of fate
definitions.explanation: The way things happen to come together, often attributed to fate or luck rather than planning. Can refer to fortunate or unfortunate coincidences.

examples.japanese: {運命|うんめい}の{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせで{彼|かれ}と{出会|であ}った。
examples.english: I met him through a twist of fate.

examples.japanese: {不思議|ふしぎ}な{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせだね。
examples.english: What a strange coincidence, isn't it?

examples.japanese: これも{何|なに}かの{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせかもしれない。
examples.english: This might also be some kind of fate.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{巡|めぐ}り (going around, from {巡|めぐ}る) + {合|あ}わせ (meeting, combining)
Literally: "coming around to meet"

USAGE:
{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ often implies that events were fated to happen, whether good or bad. It suggests that the circumstances were beyond one's control.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{運命|うんめい}の{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - twist of fate, destiny
・{不思議|ふしぎ}な{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - strange coincidence
・{悪|わる}い{巡|めぐ}り{合|あ}わせ - bad luck, unfortunate circumstances

RELATED WORDS:
・{縁|えん} - fate, connection, karma
・{因縁|いんねん} - fate, karma, destiny
・{宿命|しゅくめい} - destiny, fate (predetermined)
・{偶然|ぐうぜん} - coincidence (more neutral, less fated)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in both casual and literary contexts.
